        product_id
    FROM
        blinkit_products
    WHERE
        category = 'Dairy & Breakfast'
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        oi.order_id
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        JOIN dairy_products dp ON oi.product_id = dp.product_id
),
delivery_status_data AS (
    SELECT
        op.product_id,
        CASE
            WHEN dp.delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_ontime
    FROM
        order_products op
        JOIN blinkit_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id -- 确保 op.order_id 正确引用
        JOIN blinkit_delivery_performance dp ON op.order_id = dp.order_id
),
delivery_stats AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        SUM(is_ontime) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ontime_rate
    FROM
        delivery_status_data
    GROUP BY
        product_id
)
SELECT
    product_id
FROM
    delivery_stats
WHERE
    ontime_rate < 0.9

    SELECT
        product_id,
        SUM(CAST(damaged_stock AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS total_damaged,

),

        p.product_id,

        (
            CAST(i.total_damaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(i.total_received, 0)

    FROM

),

  FROM blinkit_products
), agg AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(damaged_stock::numeric) AS dmg, SUM(stock_received::numeric) AS rcv
  FROM blinkit_inventory
  GROUP BY product_id
), dmg_rate AS (
  SELECT a.product_id, p.brand, a.dmg / NULLIF(a.dmg + a.rcv, 0) AS rate, p.sld

WITH cash_items AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity, p.brand
    FROM blinkit_order_items oi
    JOIN blinkit_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN blinkit_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.payment_method = 'Cash'
),
product_contrib AS (
    SELECT product_id, brand, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_sum
    FROM cash_items
    GROUP BY product_id, brand
),
brand_contrib AS (
    SELECT brand, SUM(occurrence_count * quantity_sum) AS total_contribution
    FROM product_contrib
    GROUP BY brand
),
total_contrib AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_contribution) AS grand_total
    FROM brand_contrib
)
SELECT bc.brand,

FROM brand_contrib bc

WHERE tc.grand_total IS NOT NULL
